provenance.label: Approximate strategies for specified finite postflop games, not exact or universal GTO. Ranges are hand-written teaching assumptions, not solved preflop play. The reported whole-game exploitability grades the complete unrounded native policy; rounded partial saved slices are not separately certified. Local re-solving is not a global guarantee.
